title: 异形圆管工件下料优化问题
source: 2026 杭州电子科技大学 第27届大学生数学建模竞赛 B题
notes: SCHEMA HAS NO OPTIMA. All numeric results come exclusively from solve tools + validate. Shell fixture 'tube_cut_b2026' is pipeline reference only; this schema describes the TRUE contest subproblems from intake. No objective/path/tour/routes/best_cost values anywhere in this file.

subproblems.title: 轴向占用长度计算与基础下料方案
subproblems.description: 10种工件各50件。根据附件1点云计算各工件轴向占用长度。允许组合选用4种标准母材(9/10/11/12m)，设计下料方案。不考虑共切效应。

objective_hierarchy.description: 所选母材总长度尽可能小
不同工件之间的切换次数尽可能少

subproblems.notes: 母材利用率 = Σ(工件轴向占用长度) / Σ(所选母材总长度)

subproblems.title: 共切收益模型与固定分配重排序
subproblems.description: 在Q1基础上考虑共切效应。建立4种端部拼接方式(LL/LR/RL/RR)的省料通用模型，计算10×10×4共切收益矩阵。保持Q1工件到母材的分配不变，仅在各母材内部对工件重新排序。

objective_hierarchy.description: 不同工件之间的切换次数尽可能少

subproblems.notes: 母材利用率 = [Σ(工件轴向占用长度) - 总共切收益] / Σ(所选母材总长度)。内部拼接(同型工件连续)不计入切换次数。

subproblems.title: 含共切收益的全新下料方案
subproblems.description: 结合共切收益矩阵，重新制定所有工件的下料方案。综合考虑母材总长度、总共切收益、总切换次数。余料≥200mm可入库后续批次优先使用，<200mm为废料。

objective_hierarchy.description: 不同工件之间的切换次数尽可能少

remnant_rule.description: 余料≥200mm可入库，后续批次优先使用；<200mm视为废料

subproblems.notes: 联合优化：assignment + ordering + splice。CP-SAT规模较大，可能需要分解策略。

subproblems.title: 多批次连续加工与余料调用
subproblems.description: 3个连续批次(B1/B2/B3)需求数据。每批次余料≥200mm入库供下一批次优先使用。多批次联合优化：余料调用、新母材选取、拼接方式、加工顺序。

objective_hierarchy.description: 3批次总共使用标准母材总长度尽可能小

remnant_rule.description: 余料≥200mm入库；后续批次优先使用库存余料后再取新母材

subproblems.notes: 多期库存模型。B1无前期余料；B2/B3优先消耗前批次余料(≥200mm)后再采购新母材。

constraints.description: 每种工件需求数量必须精确满足
每根母材上工件轴向占用总长度(考虑共切后) ≤ 母材长度
母材仅可选9m/10m/11m/12m四种标准长度
暂不考虑切割损耗与首尾夹持余量
共切仅发生在相邻加工工件之间(同母材内)
共切端部组合限于LL/LR/RL/RR四种方式
Q2工件到母材的分配固定为Q1方案
余料≥200mm可入库供后续批次使用
余料<200mm视为废料，不可再利用
后续批次优先使用库存余料，再取新母材
相同工件尽可能集中连续加工，减少切换
工件外半径20mm，内半径19mm，壁厚1mm; 横截面近似圆形
Q4各批次需求独立; B1总468件, B2总433件, B3总427件

steps: Read CSV point cloud (X,Y,Z) for each of 10 workpiece types
Compute PCA; first principal component = axial direction
Project all points onto PCA axis; span = axial_length (max - min)
Identify end-zone neighborhoods; compute r_mean per end
Classify L end (smaller r_mean) and R end (larger r_mean)
geometry_preprocessing.output: axial_lengths_per_type_mm + L/R end classification per type
geometry_preprocessing.notes: Research suggests types G5-G9 may be L≈R symmetric. Axial lengths span ~75mm to ~400mm across types.

co_cut_preprocessing.internal_splice: Same-type consecutive workpieces use LR alternating for max benefit; (n-1) joints per block of n items
co_cut_preprocessing.block_between_splice: Different-type adjacent blocks; max over 4 modes; counts as 1 type switch
co_cut_preprocessing.notes: Simplified radial-difference model is a FEASIBLE heuristic, not proven optimal for co-cut benefit. STP CAD files available for precise cross-section matching if needed. For symmetric types (L=R), all splice modes yield Δ ≈ 0.

result_format.block_convention: Gk×n = n consecutive workpieces of type k forming one block

solve_mode_rationale: Cutting stock is a discrete combinatorial optimization problem. CP-SAT (OR-Tools) suits bin-packing formulations with assignment variables. Can prove optimality for Q1 (pure 1D CSP at 500 items). Q2 (fixed-assignment reorder) is a small per-stock ordering problem. Q3/Q4 scale may require decomposition or heuristic fallback. HiGHS MIP is alternative exact approach. Note: solver stack (docs/solver-stack.md) has no dedicated cutting_stock entry; CP-SAT at L2 is recommended for discrete OR.

meta.proven_optimal_achievable: Q1 only (pure 1D cutting stock at 500 items via CP-SAT bin-packing). Q2-Q4 may require heuristic components for co-cut ordering at scale.
open_questions: Co-cut precision: is simplified |r_i - r_j| model sufficient, or parse STP CAD for precise end cross-section matching?
Q4 remnant strategy: does '优先被使用' mean remnants MUST be used before new stock, or just preferred?
Switch count definition: does switching G1→G3→G1 count as 2 switches? Are same-type blocks on different stocks counted?
CP-SAT scalability for Q3/Q4: 500 items × 4 stock types with co-cut variables may need decomposition
PCA axis sign convention consistency across all 10 types for L/R classification
Result template filling format per 结果填写说明.docx
